item.title: Take Yooka-Replaylee For A Spin In This New Switch 2 Demo
item.description: The countdown to a physical release begins.Playtonic and PM Studios have today released a free Switch 2 demo for the throwback platforming remake Yooka-Replaylee, giving you a chance to try before you buy.You'll find the new demo on the Switch 2 eShop right now, and, you'll be pleased to hear, all the data carries over to the full game — so there's no time wasted if you choose to go all-in on the full release afterwards.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Assassin's Creed Shadows Update To Resolve Switch 2 Crashes And Stability Issues
item.description: It's scheduled for "next week".Last week, we ran a story here on Nintendo Life about how Assassin's Creed Shadows on Switch 2 was "unplayable" for some players due to repeated game crashes.Now, in a post on the official Assassin's Creed social media account, Ubisoft has acknowledged these "stability issues" and how it can "lead to crashes". Fortunately, a Title Update is planned for next week, and it will include fixes for these issues on Switch 2.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: F-Zero 99 Update Version 1.7.0 Now Live - New Secret Tracks, Music Player, And Much More
item.description: Download it now!Nintendo's been busy getting in its final updates of 2025, and alongside a system update for the Switch 2 and Switch this week, it's also put out a new update for its battle royale racer F-Zero 99.According to the official patch notes, this includes "new additions", various adjustments and changes, as well as the usual fixes. item.title: Nintendo Music Adds Another Yoshi Soundtrack, Here's Every Song Included
item.description: Welcome back, Yoshi's Crafted World!Following on from a sample of Metroid Prime 4: Beyond's soundtrack last week, Nintendo Music has now followed this up with the 2019 Switch title Yoshi's Crafted World.This follows on from other Yoshi-themed albums like Yoshi's Story from the N64 era and Yoshi's Island on the Super Nintendo. This latest soundtrack update contains 53 tracks and has a runtime of 1 hour and 11 minutes.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
